%md
# Ask Governed Finance Questions with Select AI

This AI4U-style notebook compares SELECT AI CHAT, SELECT AI SHOWSQL, and SELECT AI NARRATE using the existing Seer Bank Finance LiveStack dataset. Run each paragraph in order.

%md
## Activate the governed finance profile

The FINANCE_V2_GENAI profile limits Select AI to the approved finance objects provisioned for this workshop.

%md
## Experience Select AI Chat

CHAT answers with general model knowledge. It does not query the Seer Bank objects in the profile.

%script
SELECT AI CHAT What business factors commonly increase fraud and compliance risk at a financial institution?;

%script
SELECT AI CHAT Which Seer Bank risk signal currently has the highest criticality score?;

%md
## Verify the existing finance objects

The Finance version uses the workshop dataset instead of creating AI4U's separate sample loan table.

%script
SELECT object_name,
       object_type
FROM user_objects
WHERE object_name IN (
  'FINANCE_PRODUCTS_V',
  'RISK_SIGNALS_V',
  'SIGNAL_SOURCES_V',
  'POST_PRODUCT_MENTIONS',
  'AGENT_ACTIONS'
)
ORDER BY object_name;

%md
## Show the generated SQL

Review the SQL and confirm that it reads only approved finance objects.

%script
SELECT AI SHOWSQL Which Seer Bank product categories have the highest current risk exposure?;

%md
## Ask Select AI to query and narrate

Unlike CHAT, NARRATE can ground the answer in the approved Seer Bank data.

%script
SELECT AI NARRATE Which Seer Bank product categories have the highest current risk exposure?;

%md
## Verify the answer with stable SQL evidence

Generated wording and aliases can vary. These database rows are the stable evidence check.

%script
SELECT fp.product_category,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rs.signal_id) AS signal_count,
       ROUND(AVG(rs.criticality_score), 1) AS avg_criticality,
       SUM(rs.exposure_count) AS exposure_count
FROM risk_signals_v rs
JOIN post_product_mentions ppm
  ON ppm.post_id = rs.signal_id
JOIN finance_products_v fp
  ON fp.financial_product_id = ppm.product_id
GROUP BY fp.product_category
ORDER BY exposure_count DESC
FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY;

%md
## Prove that Select AI remains read-only

The agent action count must not change when NARRATE answers another finance question.

%md
## Result

You reproduced the AI4U progression with the Finance LiveStack dataset: CHAT explained general knowledge, SHOWSQL exposed the generated statement, and NARRATE queried governed finance data without taking action.
